summary: WasteGuard.tsx JSX compile-fix regression verified fixed. All 3 acceptance criteria pass via browser checks against the public preview URL on mobile viewport.

checks.criterion: The public preview no longer shows the reported Emergent build error overlay for WasteGuard.tsx JSX compilation
checks.name: wasteguard-login-loads-without-build-error
checks.evidence: Navigated to https://chat-platform-528.preview.emergentagent.com/login at 390x844 viewport; page body did not contain 'Failed to load'/'Part of the app failed to load'/'Stack trace'/'Reload app' text; WasteGuard branded login screen rendered with 'Citizen' persona text visible. Cross-checked with curl to /src/pages/WasteGuard.tsx which returned HTTP 200 with valid compiled JS (jsxDEV output), confirming no babel/vite parse error. Note: /var/log/supervisor/frontend.err.log contains a STALE babel JSX error stack trace from before the fix (file mtime 17:01:13 UTC, prior to this check run at 17:07); current live compile is healthy.

checks.criterion: The WasteGuard login interface remains usable after the compile fix
checks.name: wasteguard-login-controls-interactive
checks.evidence: On mobile viewport (390x844): Citizen, Admin, Worker persona buttons visible and clickable; clicked Admin persona successfully; email input filled with admin@example.com, password input filled with admin123; 'Enter WasteGuard' submit button visible and enabled.

checks.criterion: The fixed preview has no frontend runtime failure
checks.name: wasteguard-login-no-console-errors
checks.evidence: Loaded /login with console 'error' listener and requestfailed listener attached before navigation. Zero console errors captured; zero failed first-party (chat-platform-528.preview.emergentagent.com / /src/* ) asset requests observed after page reached interactive state (Citizen button visible).

notes: Backend was not touched by this fix (pure frontend JSX syntax regression); no new backend test file was required since none of the 3 criteria are API-bearing. Backend health was confirmed healthy via curl to http://localhost:8001/api/ and /docs (both 200) as a sanity cross-check.
This iteration re-verified an already-existing bug report scenario; the fix is confirmed live and working on the public preview URL.
